name: Permanent Residence ID

requirements.blocker_text: 3 preceding years of domicile in Ethiopia with lawful income and good character.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 3 years of continuous legal domicile.

requirement_groups.name: Foreign spouse of an Ethiopian national

requirements.blocker_text: 1 year of marriage to an Ethiopian national.

sources.title: Immigration and Citizenship Service (ICS), Ethiopia -- service catalogue describes 'Permanent Residence ID' as a five-year renewable permit

Dablo Law Firm -- summary of permanent residence eligibility: 3 years' prior domicile with lawful income and good character, OR 1 year of marriage to an Ethiopian national, OR expedited approval for investors/humanitarian-activity cases; permanent residence does not itself confer work or investment authorization -- a separate permit is still required

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Ethiopia). STRUCTURAL FINDING, TIER-3 SOURCED BUT WORTH FLAGGING: Ethiopia's 'permanent residence' is explicitly a renewable 5-year permit, not an indefinite status -- a meaningfully different structure from 'permanent residence' as modeled in most other countries in this dataset. The same tier-3 source states PR does NOT by itself confer work or investment authorization -- a separate permit is still required even after obtaining PR -- reflected here as work_rights='restricted' rather than 'full', but flagged as unconfirmed at tier-1/2. A third eligibility track (investors/humanitarian-activity cases via expedited approval) is disclosed but not separately modeled given thin detail.
